notes.title: Community Patch #3 - Multiplayer Improvements & Quality of Life Changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Following on from the recent [b]Trick-or-Yeet Update[/b] we've been working on implementing requested fixes and some small Quality of Life changes. We were really pleased to see the positive response to the new multiplayer PvP options and we hope these changes continue to make everyone's experience smoother! 

See you out there kicking butt! 

Cinder Cone & Modern Wolf

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Peasant clothing and items display correctly
[*] Fixed typo in online message
[/list]
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Client player Ghosts being stuck uncontrollable in Network play
[*] Clients can't get stuck in shop or portrait interactions if host quits
[*] Clients can no longer get stranded if a host leaves while a level is loading
[*] Corrected sportsball visibility for Clients, sportsball dies correctly when a goal is scored
[*] Charged attacks display for other players correctly over the network, charged attacks triggered over the network can no longer be prevented by lack of resources
[*] Adjusted instruction text in PvP modes to display correctly for all levels
[/list]
[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Moved PvP sign in HQ to be more visible
[/list]
The build number for this patch is [b]1.1.5[/b].

notes.title: TRICK-OR-YEET YOUR WAY TO VICTORY!
notes.notes:
Get ready for spoOooOOoktacular news coming to a scream near you with a huge monster update for Skeleton Crew. The New [b]TRICK-or-YEET[/b] edition brings your friends across from a parallel universe with its kick-ass multiplayer feature at [b]10% OFF[/b]! 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/X2WYK9y/Skeleton-Crew-Halloween-Update-Key-Art-Discount.png[/img]

Square off with up to three friends in a fight for survival in the TEAM DEATHMATCH round where every moment you don't spend kicking guarantees your death. 

Get plastered in feathers as you capture frantic chickens and bring them home to roost. If you're not careful the fire will get them and then you can add an 'A' to roost and well...you get the picture.

In the Sportsball round, you can freestyle it on the court and get dunking to score points against your opponents. Be warned this environment is like no other! Hazards will meet you every step of the way and might just be your doom. 

If this wasn't enough of a treat for you the [b]SLAYER EDITION[/b] featuring the Origins Digital Comic AND the Official Soundtrack is getting a scarily good [b]34% Discount[/b] for your viewing pleasure! 

[b]Team up or all play against each other and put your friendships on the line.[/b]

notes.title: Community Patch #2 - Multiplayer Tweaks, Visual Fixes and More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

 We're happy to announce that we have a new patch live!💀🦵 We hope you've been enjoying Skeleton Crew so far! We're overjoyed to see all of the positive feedback the game has been receiving and want you to know that we appreciate it from the bottom of our hearts! 

Thanks to the helpful feedback from our Steam discussions and Discord, we've made some tweaks based off of the issues and suggestions you guys raised!

- Cinder Cone & Modern Wolf

[h2][u]Patch notes:[/u][/h2]

[h3]MULTIPLAYER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player Characters play fall animations correctly when networked
[*] Carried items no longer flip upside down when carrying character changes facing direction
[*] Selected inventory item no longer constantly rehighlights
[*] Destroyable enemy spawners and traps now have their health synchronised over network
[*] Shop items and their positions are correctly synced over the network
[*] Fixed Networked AI Character glitches
[*] Improve connectivity between continental regions
[/list]
[h3]MISC
[/h3][list]
[*] Improved performance with optimised settings for various animated characters and objects
[*] Fixed YEET highlight shader on characters
[*] Mouse Aim Sensitivity setting added
[*] Improved behaviour for kicked characters bouncing off of ceilings
[/list]

See you out there kicking butt! 

The build number for this patch is [b]1.0.10[/b]

notes.title: Community Patch #1 - Steam Deck, Remote Play, and more!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been such a joy seeing so many of you enjoying this game we’ve spent the better part of the past few years working on. After taking some health potions, a roast chicken, and a fair whack of sleep, we’ve spent the past couple of weeks diving into the piles of feedback we’ve received so far and kicking it into our backend systems for us to start working through. This patch is the first step in our journey to making Skeleton Crew the best game it can be and we’re glad you’re all now on that journey with us! 

Alongside the changes below we’re excited to be activating Remote Play capability so now you can play local co-op with your friends over the internet and stream the game to your TV, let us know how it goes for you (and feel free to share snaps of you playing Skeleton Crew on the [b]biggest TV[/b] you can find 📺)!

Whilst we’ve been focused on some of the more specific feedback we’ve received so far, if you have further comments and suggestions for us please [url=https://discord.gg/GCCU7AJSkU]join our Discord[/url] where you can discuss all things Skeleton Crew! Speaking of Discord, a special thank you to some of our Discord members such as @HeyEllwood, @Aardappel, @DodGie, @Zaek (and others!) for providing bug reports and logs - it’s much appreciated ❤️

See you out there kicking butt! 

Cinder Cone & Modern Wolf

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Option to Skip Tutorial added to pause menu
[*] Option to disable Cursor Position lock during gameplay to aid MHOOK support
[*] UI scaling adjusted to properly support 32:9 aspect ratio
[*] Completing any level should trigger any level-specific achievements that a player should have but doesn't
[/list]
[h3]Steam Deck[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition of Steam Cloud Save support (including dynamic sync for Steam Deck)
[*] Changed video codecs for playback on Steam Deck
[/list]
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed steam invites not working in some cases
[/list]
[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list]
[*] General balancing improvements and bug fixes such as selecting Gimbal via the hero/time trial 'Change Level' option causing issues and Gilliam's water dash ability affecting NPCs at the YEET HQ
[/list]

The build number for this patch is [b]1.0.5[/b].

We're so happy to announce that [b]Skeleton Crew[/b] is out and you can get to kicking butts all day long! It's been a long road but we're so excited to welcome you to the crumbling world of Karpathia, where humans are the endangered species. Only the Yeoman Eldritch Extermination Team (Y.E.E.T) can protect humanity against the hordes of chaos and we need you to join them today to exterminate the undead menace! 

Don't kick our new shiny trailer unless it is to show it to your friends the only way we know how!

PLUS the original soundtrack by Richard Wilkinson with classics such as

And so much more for you to explore, so what are you waiting for? Gear up and meet us at Y.E.E.T headquarters. We're waiting...

notes.title: 💀 Skeleton Crew release date is here! 💀
notes.notes:
On the 16th June 2022, the Yeoman Eldritch Extermination Team (Y.E.E.T.) are enlisting your services to tackle legions of monsters trying to decimate what’s left of mankind.

To celebrate the release date reveal, Skeleton Crew is taking part in Steam Next Fest until the 28th of February, with a brand new demo of the game available now. 

As part of Steam Next Fest, you can explore the world of Skeleton Crew, watch livestreams of the game in action, and chat with the team directly! 

Battle your way through 17 hand-crafted dungeons either solo or up to 4-players, in Co-op, Local or Online play. 

Kick everything in your path! Skulls? Sure! chickens? You got it! Your friends? Absolutely! A weaponised environment ensuring you get to take out the undead your way.

12 playable and upgradable characters like Drago, the Vampire Baronet, Tristesse, the Weeping Paladin and Cichol, the Bloodless King.

To keep up with the action, join the Skeleton Crew Discord channel below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35678563/16752c384f8ce5a82bf34e03d34dab7c810f7c52.png[/img]

Great news everyone! Skeleton Crew is part of Gamescom and that means you can play our very fun demo which gives a teasing taste of what lies ahead in the full game containing 17 hand-crafted lush non-linear levels to explore.

Here's what awaits you in the lands of Livmore:

⚔️ A selection of unique characters, each with their own backstories and special skillsets
⚔️ Multilayered combat approaches to dealing with chaotic and frankly mean enemies
⚔️ Local MP 
⚔️ Fun platforming and use of pinball physics to traverse the realms you explore
⚔️ Many objects to throw at inanimate trigger objects or far-too-animated undead monsters
⚔️ Collecting and buying items to aid you on your quests and make big cool explosions
⚔️ Encountering many fun and odd NPC characters
⚔️ Spotting areas you can further explore using different characters abilities
⚔️ Other secrets

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35678563/b9f4c0fb5713c9e556bb123ccfbc2df1bc94db5d.png[/img]

As part of E3 2021 and Xbox's indie showcase we're happy to announce Skeleton Crew will be coming not only to PC but also to Xbox consoles. 

[b]Stay tuned for upcoming Skeleton Crew news and competitions![/b]

[h3][b]TRY OUT THE NEW SKELETON CREW XBOX DEMO[/b][/h3]

[b]This demo features:[/b]

⚔️ Multilayered combat approaches to dealing with villainous ghoulish foes
⚔️ A selection of unique characters, each with their own backstories and special skillsets
⚔️ Fun platforming and use of pinball physics to traverse the realms you explore
⚔️ Many unusual items to throw at inanimate trigger objects or far-too-animated undead monsters
⚔️ Collecting and buying explosively cool items to aid you on your quests
⚔️ Meeting a host of fun NPCs
⚔️ Spotting areas you can further explore using different characters' abilities

[img]https://i.ibb.co/9373dGq/SC-multipurpose-vids-5.gif[/img]

We're extremely excited to be a part of the Xbox Summer Game Fest and hope you all get a chance to check out our first ever Console Demo for Skeleton Crew.

One known issues we found in the build you'll be playing: returning to main menu from gameplay will cause a softlock requiring a console reboot.

The good news is that the only reason you'd ever need to return to main menu is to start a new playthrough should you want to replay the tutorials, everything else can be accessed from the in-game world hub! So, if that's the case, please quit the game entirely and reboot to menu from OS instead.

We're sorry for any inconvenience caused by this. Aside from that, we hope you enjoy your time in Karpathia!

notes.title: Skeleton Crew - Co-op your way to stylish victory.
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/BcKD47x/SC-header-preview-800x450-copy-5.png[/img]

Skeleton Crew can be played as a solo adventure or with friends, either online or via couch co-op. Owning your own adventure is awesome and it's equally awesome to team up with friends (or enemies) to vanquish the evils of Karpathia together. 

[h1]Co-op Combat[/h1]
Distract enemies by kicking objects (alive or dead) at them, while the other player charges in for a brutal beating. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/26B5hDC7/co-oop-fight-big-boss.gif[/img]

Think of it like a cannonball-special but instead of a metal Russian X-Men throwing an angry little clawed X-Men you're flinging skulls, explosions, or a fearsome cabbage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35678563/ad6f360f7e907ef133ca37925d041a112d637d10.jpg[/img]

Both single and co-op offer a range of ways to attack, defend, and traverse the world levels. 

It's not just for combat, but joining forces can help you activate levers and the like to help further progress through the level or to open up secret areas. While I slay these ugly skeleton bois how about you get to work on raising that super thick gothic door or lowering the draw bridge.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/NLvB19dg/co-op-fight-gardens.gif[/img]

There's a lot that can be done in Skeleton Crew and we won't spoil it all. This is just a sliver of the different combinations you can use with a teammate. If you enjoy speed running games, then what better way to up those numbers (or rather lowering them) than having a friend help you.

We're excited to see all the co-op combination playstyles when the game releases. If you want more ways to connect to Skeleton Crew and the devs, check out these links 👇

notes.title: Skeleton Crew - Investigating your inventory
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/7y3jjpR/SC-header-preview-800x450-x5.png[/img]

There's a lot of depth to the combat and platforming gameplay of Skeleton Crew. While you figure out what style works for you and the various characters you can play as it's worth getting familiar with elements of the game that are always there to help you. None more prominent than ye olde satchel of life-saving, skull-crushing items aka your inventory. 🎒

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vXcTGdv/Newton-Screenshots-28-04-2021-0-01-23-07.png[/img]

With all the action going on as you traverse Kaparthia, slaying ghouls and bashing the ever-loving yeet out of enemies, you may forget that your character has inventory slots and they can be used to add a great advantage to your gameplay.

If your health is low you can gather potions to heal yourself during the game but if you're in dire need of edging away from the brink of death, it always helps to keep some stored for easy access. Potions come in 5 different forms - damage, haste, spirit, health and armour). Such items can be picked up post-battle or bought from a shoppe.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/h8phQvm/12.png[/img]

Items only become available to sit in your inventory once you've found them in-game. Keep an eye out for items that enemies, especially bosses drop. You can pick them up and use them there and then or store for future carnage.

Don't fancy lobbing a pumpkin 🎃 quite yet but have seen one that's taken your fancy? Pop it in your inventory for later on. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/dW886Jt/Object2.png[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KFrZ0T5/Object1.png[/img]

We don't want to spoil the fun so soon, there are a lot of items and play styles to try out in Skeleton Crew. We're looking forward to seeing what ye brave heroes come up with when the game launches.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/HTLH14t/unlock.gif[/img]

We hope you're enjoying these spotlight posts on Skeleton Crew and are getting hyped for when the game releases (we're hoping to announce that soon!).

Meanwhile, if you fancy it, check out these links for staying up to date and joining the community👇

notes.title: Skeleton Crew Dev log - Introducing Elgar
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/hRDYVPC/SC-header-preview-800x450-x4.png[/img]

Well met fellow travellers and warriors to another episode where we get to know more about Skeleton Crew. Come sit and let us tell you about the brave knight protector of Karpathia.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MgbCdw9/Characters-and-Lore.png[/img]
Elgar led his first company onto the battlefield when we was 9 years old. From the cradle to the grave, he gnashed his teeth and flung himself at evil with a stoic attitude and a passion for justice. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/99r5ZwP/EDGAR.png[/img]

"[i]Even in his later years, Elgar was the kindest and deadliest person I've ever known.[/i]"   🤭🗡️

[img]https://i.ibb.co/CQrkfpG/Elgar.gif[/img]

A grizzled veteran and one of the eight founding members of the Order, Elgar's secret motto is "[i]fake it till you make it[/i]". He's been faking it for a very long time.

🛡️ [b]Lance A Lot![/b] Using his charging drill attack, Elgar is able to break through barriers that others cannot.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/7YjVqQX/Elgar2.gif[/img]

His armour protects him not just from enemy attacks, but from his own deep-seated insecurities.

notes.title: Skeleton Crew Dev log - Meet Lila and Unity awards news.
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/XkP8Bb6/SC-header-preview-800x450-x3.png[/img]
Welcome to the crumbling world of Karpathia - with legions of monsters trying to decimate what’s left of mankind, only the Yeoman Eldritch Extermination Team (Y.E.E.T!) can protect humanity against the hordes of chaos. 

In this episode, we reveal another character you can play and talk about recent award nominations we were part of (yay)!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MgbCdw9/Characters-and-Lore.png[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/RYmcZxx/LILA.png[/img]
Lila was kidnapped along with the rest of her Night Elf tribe and put to work in the depths of hell. Her name is a variant of the Hebrew and Arabic word for "night".

After signing a blood contract with an Archdemon (which we would normally advise against), she was able to free her sisters, but at a great cost. She spent many years killing friends and foes alike in Ordog's Arena. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/pjDgjVD/Steam-annouc-Lila-gif.gif[/img]

Lila spent years learning the Night Elf teleport dash. Her double-jump technique will help get you out of tight situations where you're surrounded by undead ghouls and let you reach areas that contain shiny loot and secrets.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/mRfFZdY/Behing-the-Crew.png[/img]
Skeleton Crew is made with Unity and we were super delighted to be told we got nominated for a Unity award. We didn't win but to be fair, it was a tight race, and seeing our game pop up on IGN was really cool.

[previewyoutube=eciP7ixTNec;full][/previewyoutube]

Unity has incredibly supportive during the development of Skeleton Crew, so a big thank you from us. 

Thanks for coming along to this dev update of Skeleton Crew. If you want to chat about any aspects of the game's development or story you're very welcome to join our Discord and Steam forums.

notes.title: Skeleton Crew Dev log - Karpathia Catchup #2
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/51Jkkzj/SC-header-preview-800x450-x2.png[/img]

Welcome to the crumbling world of Karpathia a land that desperately needs your help as you joining the Yeoman Eldritch Extermination Team (Y.E.E.T!) to vanquish ghouls and monsters.

So let's find out more about the characters you can switch between on your adventures.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MgbCdw9/Characters-and-Lore.png[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vVh1XbS/BYRON.png[/img]


[b]Description[/b]
Byron was once condemned to damnation for their petty sins, which were plenty. They were able to trick one of Hell's princes into returning them to Karpathia. Well aware of what awaited them, Byron became hellbent on bringing the demons to their knees.  


[b]Abilities[/b]:
Byron uses their whip to pull objects towards them.

Each character has their own style of blocking, using shields or elemental powers. Byron here likes to show off with a little flare using a dodge roll as a means of blocking. We also accept the "whip 'n' roll".

notes.title: New publisher Modern Wolf declare commitment to ethical game development
notes.notes:
New wee indie publisher Modern Wolf announced themselves to the world this week, and made a big show of declaring they are “committed to ethical game development.” Their initial lineup of five games sounds pretty neat, including the next games from the studios behind Neo Scavenger and Out There. More folks in the industry do talk openly about its troubles these days but it’s still rare for a publisher to make a big selling point of how they treat workers, so I asked Modern Wolf CEO Fernando Rizo more about what that means.

“Consumers are starting to care about how their games are made, and we are striving to be the most ethical creator of games around,” he told me.

(more…)
